reviews.title: Great Concept, Poor Execution
reviews.text: I appreciate the idea behind this styling app, but it’s just not realistic. It doesn’t capture my face or body type accurately at all, which makes the outfit previews pretty pointless. Even though it does offer some outfit ideas that could be useful in theory, most of them don’t match my vibe or personal style whatsoever. It feels like the app tries to be personalized, but everything ends up looking generic. If it could actually scan people correctly and offer styles based on real preferences, it would be so much better.

reviews.title: A new virtual Styling Era
reviews.text:
使用gensmo有一段时间了，总体体验非常棒！足不出户就能在家体验各大品牌的服装效果，生成的造型我基本都挺满意。当然，目前在使用过程中也遇到了一些小bug，希望开发团队能持续迭代优化。非常期待未来gensmo能从2D升级到3D，扫描我的身材、脸型，创建专属虚拟数字人，带来更真实、更个性化的穿搭体验。
五星好评，鼓励开发团队继续加油，希望gensmo能不断进化，最终成为女生中的现象级应用！
I've been using gensmo for a while, and my overall experience has been wonderful! It's amazing to try on outfits from various brands right from home, and I'm quite satisfied with the styles it generates. Of course, there are still some minor bugs to iron out, and I look forward to seeing continuous improvements. I'm especially excited about the potential evolution from 2D to 3D—hopefully soon it can scan my body and facial features, creating a personalized virtual avatar for an even more realistic fashion experience.
Five-star encouragement for the dev team! Keep up the great work—I hope gensmo continues to evolve and ultimately becomes a phenomenal app among women everywhere!
